verdicts.reason: A breaks the product imagery. The orange can has been pulled out of its cream circle, so it nearly disappears against the orange background, and the empty circle floats beside it with no purpose. The top third is dead space, and the NEW and Try It buttons have lost their rounded shape and don't line up in height or vertical position. B keeps the can inside its circle, but the circle is jammed into the top-left corner and cut off by the canvas edges. The subhead is indented away from the headline's left edge, the buttons are right-aligned on a third axis, and the empty right side makes the layout feel ragged.
